title: relay as a portable tool, project data out of relay
what: Front's proposal (24 Oct), accepted for the owner's personal projects; Glonass stays outside relay as before (its rule and its projects are not moved in or out by this item; decide its place at build time with the owner).
- Which rules a project loads: today relay's projects.toml lists 13 projects with this machine's paths; becomes a relay settings file inside each project's repo.
- The list of projects on a machine: not stored in relay; derived from the folders where `relay setup` ran (machine-local, not in git).

- A project's Claude memory (raw notes): a folder in the project's own repo; `relay sync` writes `autoMemoryDirectory` into the project's .claude/settings.local.json (Claude Code 2.1.309 ignores that key in the checked-in .claude/settings.json, allows it in settings.local.json or user settings; verified in the binary's schema text 24 Oct). A note written mid-session must land in git at once without dirtying the main checkout (like `relay queue` items land) and the main-checkout guard must allow it. A project whose repo is shared can set "memory local" (stays in ~/.claude).
- The owner's facts (native language, subscription, paid-run cap): a personal file outside the relay repo; relay asks once on a new machine.
- Project names in relay's rules (ALIX bin/wt, arsenal .worktrees) move to those projects' settings.

- Principles (the 9 sections drafted 24 Oct, called "principles" by the owner: "Те разделы вкуса что ты привел, назовем их принципами - паттерны поведения и принятия решений, они мне по душе"): a generic part of relay with no project references; the examples go to relay's docs. Built from memory notes, not replacing them. Draft page: https://claude.ai/artifact/NQRwk9vQKBpbuP43kEEosu (generator: the 0cc68fe0 session scratchpad gen_taste.py).
Rough cost: 3-4 changes of 30-60 agent minutes, 2-3 paid runs (~$9 each).
why: Owner, 24 Oct, verbatim: "моя цель - свежая копия relay + <project> работает одинаково на всех машинах"; "relay - переносимая утилита, пусть она и базируется на моем опыте, но она должна остаться переносимой, без ссылок на другие проекты"; "заменять память не стоит - лучше научиться ей управлять, почему мы не можем хранить память о всех проектах в самих проектах, сохранять их в гит и легко переносить между машинами"; "память лишь записывает, из памяти в дальнейшем мы собираем функциональные компоненты системы, каким может стать "вкус", память это заметки, claude уже умеет с этим работать, мы лишь управляем"; "Правила glonass мы оставляем вне, по старому, для всем моих личных проектах твои правила вполне, glonass также остается вне relay"; "запиши сейчас куда-нибудь, чтобы после уже на этапе полного изолирования утилиты (когда я начну её активно применять) мы смогли это восстановить из заметок". Timing: later, when the owner starts using relay actively; ip is the owner's (default 0).

fact: Migration 27 Oct: the link in `what` line 7 points to a session file (the page generator `gen_taste.py` of session 0cc68fe0's session folder), which is deleted when the machine restarts; the facts it held that this item rests on are the notes below.

Recovered 27 Oct: `gen_taste.py` (438 lines, in the other session's session folder) builds taste-draft.html, the page the item links: the taste sections (rule texts), the memory map, the capture path and the owner questions. It is not copied to the backup folder; the page itself is the claude.ai artifact the item links.

fact: 29 Oct, design "relay in Claude cloud environments" revision 2 (thinker, critic, revision; measured at master 420a69a1). Documented: a cloud session is an Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 VM, about 4 vCPU, 16 GB, 30 GB; no plugins installed (even repo-enabled), no user-level CLAUDE.md, settings, hooks or MCP; code goes home only through GitHub (push, teleport); the VM loses its files when reclaimed; Docker preinstalled, podman not documented. Measured: average gate wait for a slot 253 s, median 0 (66 of 113 gates did not wait); front sessions 7 transcripts, median 12.5 h; relay's head tree 2.75 MB compressed, full history 8.4 MiB; a gate alone on 4 vCPU scales to about 1,260 s, sharing the VM about 2,586 s against the 1,800 s limit. Eight points undocumented (setup-script-written settings loaded, podman installs, nested claude -p logged in, gate time, background job keeps the VM, push to own host, model of --cloud, which environment). Recommendation: later, own Linux VMs first.
